the completing tick removes the note it was handed
a shipping span over a standing note, and one that removed it

summary: Nothing refuses a completing commit that leaves its continuing note standing, so an orphan outlives the entry it described
acceptance: a build commit that ships its entry while a continuing note for that tag still stands is refused, naming the path it left behind
tests: a build commit shipping its entry over a standing continuing note is refused
notes: The note leaves with the ship (per the section). Build's own commit removes it — same channel, same fence, same tick that was handed it — and the gate is what keeps that from being prose alone (`.claude/rules/engineering.md`, *Loud or nothing*). A tick that wrote a continuing note this span touched the path, so it is not the case this refuses.
pins: a build commit that removed its entry's continuing note passes the records gate
